scope: Fix visual-number association only; no Goal, Choice instructions, exploration algorithm, action bindings or completion threshold changes.
implementation: Prefer a badge in its own outlined control's unused padding, avoiding visible DOM text rectangles and unrelated offered controls. Otherwise use a nearest readable outside position. Containing background controls do not prohibit foreground numbering. Text strings, style cache and collision rectangles remain local to the browser evaluation; no DOM/OCR text is added to Jev input.

redThenGreen: packed navigation sends badges to remote rows
full-screen background control prevents foreground badge placement
invisible text consumes all placement space, including inherited opacity/filter, visibility and transparent text fill
preserved: candidate identity and actual click binding
screenshot and DOM cleanup including capture failure

pairedProbe.protocol: Same frozen page, current screenshot only, identical questions/candidates/state, pinned Jev 1.14.0. Three fresh requests per annotation variant, each asks two link-number questions. No expected ID or route supplied. This is a separate instrument probe, not Goal exploration or a human UX measurement.
pairedProbe.rejectedAttempt: Avoiding other target rectangles without an explicit local association was insufficient: kids=uncertain/rules=e2 in all three paired after requests. Retained locally at reports/numbering-fix-2026-10-19T06-58-10.715Z/.

execution.imageReview: The final captured image visibly includes the work, the rule 遊べるのは小学生まで, and クツはぬいでね（雨の日もだよ）. This is a source-image check, not an assertion that all weather/operation conditions have been exhaustively verified.

publicScope: Previously reviewed same museum, read-only, sequential, 2000ms action interval, no action-count cap. No forms, login, purchases or policy bypass. Original reports untouched. Site images and raw model responses remain local, not committed.

verification.note: An earlier full suite was intentionally interrupted before final review fixes; it is not claimed as a pass. The completed final suite ran against fixed production and test files from scratch; file hashes were rechecked unchanged afterwards.
verification.review: All independently reproduced Important findings resolved; no outstanding Critical or Important findings in reviewed scope.

limits: One real site and three fresh paired requests per variant do not establish a general accuracy rate
Arbitrary pseudo-element/shadow/iframe/image text and full CSS paint reconstruction are not implemented
An image-only logo/icon can still be partly covered by its own badge
A fully packed viewport may still explicitly fail placement instead of painting an ambiguous number
Goal completion remains model perceived; original objectiveSuccess stays null
